summary_1line: Bharata asks Guha to ferry the royal party and army across the Ganges, and hundreds of boats are assembled for the crossing.

image_candidates.scene_text: Five hundred boats gather along the Ganges bank as Guha steers the ornate barge 'Swastika' carrying Bharata, Shatrughna, and the queens.
At dawn the riverbank fills with soldiers, priests, porters, and pilgrims bathing as the army prepares to cross the sacred Ganges.
The decorated barge with banners and tinkling bells glides over the Ganges while white woollen rugs cover its deck beneath the princes and queens.
